form.message: Project Fulcrum — registry residency and private Governance scope. Microsoft documents that ACR may store registry artifacts in its paired region; a Sweden Central registry therefore has no established Sweden Central-only guarantee. Recommendation: request a narrow registry-artifact exception for Microsoft-managed paired-region storage within Sweden, while retaining Sweden Central-only for application data, Blob storage, compute and backups. This needs the Requirements owner's revision and review; it is not a general replication, GDPR or deployment approval. Separately, you requested arranging read-only Governance scope. Provide only a private local file path, not identifiers or credentials in chat. Neither field authorizes live Azure reads yet.

registry_residency_resolution.title: Container images — resolve the ACR residency constraint
registry_residency_resolution.description: The Entra exception stays unchanged. A narrow ACR exception covers registry artifacts only, not application data or optional customer-configured geo-replication. It does not imply automatic regional recovery. A custom response may specify another exact requirement without identifying parties.
enumNames: Request a registry-only exception for Microsoft-managed paired-region storage within Sweden
Retain strict single-region registry storage — pause implementation pending a supported alternative

private_governance_scope_file.title: Governance target — private local scope-file location
private_governance_scope_file.description: Provide an absolute path outside this repository to a privately prepared JSON file identifying the intended dev tenant/subscription and proposed subscription-plus-inherited-policy read scope, or answer Not ready. Do not include tokens, keys or passwords in the file. Supplying its path authorizes reading that file for scope validation only. Exact live-read authorization will be bound separately; real identifiers and raw identifying evidence must stay out of repository artifacts.

answers.current_non_entra_residency: Sweden Central-only; no ACR exception has been approved.
answers.dev_secret_certificate_profile: managed identities plus platform-provided HTTPS can cover every required dev connection
